question: The atomic number of oxygen is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 8**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Oxygen is an element with atomic number 8.
 
• The outermost shell of an atom is called the valence shell.
 
• The number of electrons in the valence shell determines the chemical properties of an element.
 
• Oxygen is a nonmetal that is highly reactive and forms oxides with other compounds and most elements
